title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E1 — Knight of the Juggernaut
Michael's mission to protect a new, volatile substance goes awry when a motorized battering ram wrecks KITT.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E2 — Knight of the Juggernaut
Michael and a rebuilt KITT rush to stop Nordstrom (John Considine) before he can hand over the new isotope.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E3 — KITTnap
KITT falls into a trap trying to capture two convicts fleeing to South America; guest Robert F. Lyons.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E4 — Sky Knight
Hijackers threaten to kill airline passenger hostages one by one, including Bonnie.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S1 E18 — The Coward
Steve searches the Himalayas for a downed World War II plane, knowing the discovery of it could brand his father a coward.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S1 E19 — Run, Steve, Run
An underworld syndicate plans to use Steve as the prototype for a team of bionic robots to be used in robbing Fort Knox.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E1 — Nuclear Alert
Steve stows away aboard a plane carrying an illegal atomic bomb to a small nation; guests Carol Lawrence, George Gaynes.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E2 — The Pioneers
Steve must use all his powers to subdue the male of a cryogenically frozen couple.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E3 — Pilot Error
Temporarily blind Steve must take the controls of a plane to save himself and the stricken pilot (Pat Hingle), a senator.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E4 — The Pal-Mir Escort
Assassins attempt to stop Steve from delivering an ailing prime minister scheduled for the first bionic-heart implant.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E5 — The Seven Million Dollar Man
The emotional instability of a stronger bionic-man than Steve forces a showdown; guests Monte Markham, Maggie Sullivan.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E6 — Straight on 'Til Morning
Steve ignores a potential radiation hazard to help an alien (Meg Foster) evade authorities and rejoin her ship.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S2 E7 — The Midas Touch
Steve winds up trapped in a mine when he tries to prove Oscar is innocent of gold-smuggling; guest Farley Granger.
